users.careerGoal: Lead AI Engineer in a high-growth technology startup
users.bio: Aspiring AI Full Stack Developer looking to master modern web stacks & AI integration.

recommendations.title: AI Full-Stack Developer
recommendations.description: Build end-to-end web applications powered by generative AI models, vector search, and scalable backend services.
recommendations.whyGoodFit: Your background in web development and passion for modern tech aligns directly with building next-gen AI applications.
careerRoadmap: Phase 1: Master Modern Full-Stack (React 19, TypeScript, Express)
Phase 2: LLM API Integration & Serverless AI Workflows
Phase 3: Vector Databases & RAG System Architecture
Phase 4: Cloud Deployment, CI/CD & Production Scalability
keyResponsibilities: Design responsive user interfaces for modern web tools
Integrate LLMs and server-side API endpoints
Deploy microservices and cloud databases

recommendations.title: Data & Machine Learning Engineer
recommendations.description: Transform complex data streams into actionable predictive models and automated intelligent features.
recommendations.whyGoodFit: Strong analytical mindset and interest in algorithms make ML engineering a lucrative long-term path.
careerRoadmap: Phase 1: Python, Math Fundamentals & Data Wrangling
Phase 2: Supervised/Unsupervised Learning Models
Phase 3: Deep Learning, PyTorch & NLP Models
Phase 4: MLOps, Model Monitoring & Production Serving
keyResponsibilities: Preprocess structured and unstructured datasets
Train, evaluate, and tune machine learning models
Monitor model performance in production pipelines

recommendations.title: Cloud & AI Infrastructure Engineer
recommendations.description: Manage scalable cloud deployment pipelines, container orchestration, and serverless architectures.
recommendations.whyGoodFit: Suited for engineers who value system architecture, uptime reliability, and infrastructure automation.
careerRoadmap: Phase 1: Linux Administration & Bash Shell Scripting
Phase 2: Containerization with Docker & CI/CD Pipelines
Phase 3: Kubernetes Cluster Management & Terraform IaC
Phase 4: Multi-Cloud Reliability Engineering & Observability
keyResponsibilities: Build automated CI/CD deployment pipelines
Manage Docker containers and Kubernetes clusters
Optimize cloud infrastructure cost and latency

recommendations.title: Technical AI Product Manager
recommendations.description: Bridge customer needs and engineering capabilities to launch innovative software products.
recommendations.whyGoodFit: Great fit for professionals with strong communication, problem-solving, and strategic thinking.
careerRoadmap: Phase 1: Product Discovery, User Research & Agile Frameworks
Phase 2: Roadmap Definition, Technical Specifications & Metrics
Phase 3: AI Product Design, Prototyping & UX Feedback Loops
Phase 4: Product Launch Strategy, A/B Testing & Growth Optimization
keyResponsibilities: Define product vision and feature prioritization
Collaborate with engineering and design teams
Analyze key metrics and user feedback loops
